stem: A temperature sensor was moved from canopy height to the ceiling during cleaning and not returned. What is the best technician action?
choices: Leave it because higher locations are always more accurate
Restore the approved placement if authorized and document any period when the reading may not represent the canopy
Change temperature targets to match the new location
rationale: A sensor should measure the intended environment. A placement change can make readings nonrepresentative and should be corrected and documented.
